name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention, no address residue. Accurately describes the behavior: a chapter portrait cinematic that swaps the portrait set and masks the change with a pure-white palette flash. 'chapter' is justified -- it loads the current chapter's portrait set (FDFIELD.DAT[chapter*3+2] via fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp) and is driven by chapter init paths and chapter event handlers. Keep.
purpose: Chapter portrait cinematic with a white-flash transition: pan cursor/window to a tile, swap the portrait set, then flash the screen pure white (palette +0xFF then +0) to mask the portrait change.
logic_summary: __CHK(0x10) stack-check, then straight-line: fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(x,y); fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(param_3 & 0xFF) [MOVZX low byte]; fd2_delay_ms(300); fd2_set_vga_palette_range_with_add(0,0xFF,0xFF) (pure white); fd2_delay_ms(200); fd2_set_vga_palette_range_with_add(0,0xFF,0) (restore); fd2_composite_battle_frame(0); fd2_delay_400ms_via_idle_thunk() (reached via JMP 0x353CC tail-call). Cyclomatic complexity 1, single basic block, void return.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_cinematic_chapter_portrait_dump_with_white_flash(uint32 target_tile_x, uint32 target_tile_y, uint32 chapter_id)

params.name: target_tile_x
params.semantics: Target tile/window X coordinate passed straight to fd2_pan_cursor_and_window as arg1 (callers pass map column values like 2, 0x1A, 0xF, 0x11, 9, 0).

params.name: target_tile_y
params.semantics: Target tile/window Y coordinate passed straight to fd2_pan_cursor_and_window as arg2 (callers pass map row values like 0xB, 0x1B, 0x12, 0x2C, 9).

params.name: chapter_id
params.semantics: Misnamed. Not a chapter number: only its low byte (MOVZX [ESP+0xC]) is used, forwarded to fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp @ 0x10b4e as its target_race_id -- the race/portrait-group byte (entry+0x98 in tile_event_data_table) that selects which chars in the current chapter's portrait set get (re)loaded. Callers pass small group indices: handler_34 passes ((uint8)turn-0x0E)*2 and +1 (portrait pairs 0/1,2/3,4/5,6/7); handler_3f passes 1 and 2; handler_40 passes 3,4,5; handler_42 passes 1. None pass chapter ids 1..30.
params.reason: Current name 'chapter_id' is semantically wrong -- the value is a portrait-set / race-group selector forwarded to the portrait loader's target_race_id, not a chapter number. Proposed portrait_set_id reflects its actual role. (Rename deferred to Stage 2: it changes the home signature in protos.h and is read by 16 call sites across multiple handlers; not applied here.)

returns.semantics: No return value; pure side-effect cinematic (camera pan, portrait swap, palette flash, frame composite, timed delays).

comment_original_issue: Source comment was accurate on sequence/tail-call/truncation but described the third arg only as 'chapter_id (low byte)', implying a chapter number; it did not state that the value is actually a portrait-group / race selector forwarded to the portrait loader's target_race_id. Ghidra plate was additionally stale: it used the old delay-thunk name __delay_thunk_375b2 (now fd2_delay_ms) and listed only 2 callers (handler_34 + thunk) instead of the actual 11.
notes: Decompiled body matches src 1:1; disassembly confirms MOVZX low-byte truncation of param_3 at 0x3583c and the JMP 0x353cc tail-call into fd2_delay_400ms_via_idle_thunk. param_3 true semantics established by decompiling the callee fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp @ 0x10b4e (arg matched against race byte at entry+0x98; loader's own plate names it target_race_id) plus the caller value patterns. No logic changes made (rules: name proposals recorded only, comment augmented, plate synced). reads/writes_globals empty: the function reads/writes no module globals directly -- all global state touched lives behind the callees.
